name: Ibusuki Mashiro
source: An energetic first-year student who gets along with everyone, and is a figurine and plastic model otaku. Mashiro has loved creating monsters and robots ever since she was younger. She used to be a member of the Art Club, before retiring from the club after realizing she doesn't know what she truly wants to do.
